t: The Essentials outdoor LED solar-powered spike light provides reliable illumination for domestic gardens and pathways. This modern black floor-mounted fixture is ideal for homeowners looking to highlight walkways, borders and garden features without complex wiring. Featuring an integrated daylight LED bulb that delivers 15 lumens of brightness, this durable plastic light includes an adjustable head to direct illumination precisely where needed. The IP44 rated construction ensures reliable outdoor performance, while the solar-powered rechargeable battery automatically activates at dusk to deliver 6 to 8 hours of continuous night-time operation.
